fields.name: mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.hint: Today's Picture of the Day, this date's in an earlier year, a random earlier one, or a random Commons image.

fields.name: saveAssets
fields.label: Save asset
fields.hint: Saves the image to the frame's assets folder. auto follows the frame's save-assets setting.

fields.name: metadataStateKey
fields.label: Metadata state key
fields.hint: Stores {title, description, author, license, pageUrl, imageUrl, mime} under this key.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Wikimedia Commons",
  "description": "Images from Wikimedia Commons",
  "category": "data",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "mode",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "pictureOfTheDay",
      "options": ["pictureOfTheDay", "onThisDay", "randomPictureOfTheDay", "randomImage"],
      "label": "Mode",
      "hint": "Today's Picture of the Day, this date's in an earlier year, a random earlier one, or a random Commons image."
    },
    {
      "name": "saveAssets",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "auto",
      "options": ["auto", "always", "never"],
      "label": "Save asset",
      "hint": "Saves the image to the frame's assets folder. auto follows the frame's save-assets setting."
    },
    {
      "name": "metadataStateKey",
      "type": "string",
      "value": "",
      "label": "Metadata state key",
      "placeholder": "e.g. wikimediaMetadata",
      "hint": "Stores {title, description, author, license, pageUrl, imageUrl, mime} under this key."
    }
  ],
  "output": [{ "name": "image", "type": "image" }],
  "cache": { "enabled": true, "inputEnabled": true, "durationEnabled": true, "duration": "3600" }
}

caption.name: Picture caption
caption.description: The picture's description, author and licence in a band along one edge

fields.name: fontSize
fields.label: Font size
fields.hint: On a panel 480 px or more on its shorter side; smaller ones get less.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Picture caption",
  "description": "The picture's description, author and licence in a band along one edge",
  "category": "data",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "fields": [
    { "name": "position", "type": "select", "options": ["left", "center", "right"], "value": "left", "label": "Align" },
    { "name": "vAlign", "type": "select", "options": ["top", "middle", "bottom"], "value": "bottom", "label": "Align V" },
    { "name": "fontSize", "type": "float", "value": "22", "label": "Font size", "hint": "On a panel 480 px or more on its shorter side; smaller ones get less." },
    { "name": "fontColor", "type": "color", "value": "#ffffff", "label": "Font color" },
    { "name": "bandColor", "type": "color", "value": "#000000", "label": "Band color" },
    { "name": "padding", "type": "float", "value": "12", "label": "Padding" }
  ],
  "output": [{ "name": "image", "type": "image" }]
}
